{{recipe}}

Like BBQ and like hot wings? This combines both that in one dish!

== Ingredients ==
* 24 [[Cookbook:Chicken#Wing|chicken wingettes]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|Black pepper]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|tomato paste]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* 2 Tbsp [[Cookbook:Cider Vinegar|cider vinegar]]
* 2 Tbsp [[Cookbook:Hot Sauce|hot sauce]]
* [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|Oil]] for [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep frying]]

== Procedure ==
#Sprinkle wings with salt and black pepper. 
#Heat oil to 350°F (175°C).
#[[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|Deep fry]] wings in batches for 11–12 minutes. Drain on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|cooling rack]].
#Combine liquid ingredients except for oil.
#Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over medium high heat until reduced to 10 Tbsp.
#Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes.
#[[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] wings with sauce; serve warm.
